Assemble raw detection batches into one detections table

Source: R/03_detect.R
pam_assemble_detections.Rd

Reads all batch files of a run, removes duplicates (from interrupted runs), joins recording metadata from the Stage 1 master table, and writes <detections>/<run_id>/detections.csv.

Usage

pam_assemble_detections(cfg, run_id = cfg$birdnet$run_id)

Arguments

cfg

A pam_config object.

run_id

Name of the detection run (a sub-folder of paths$detections). Defaults to birdnet$run_id.

Value

A data.table with filename, species, scientific_name, common_name, confidence, start_time and end_time (seconds into the recording), site (= grid), grid, recorder, deployment_id, in_deployment, recording_date, recording_start and detection_datetime (local time), rel.

Examples

ex <- pam_example_project()
# the later stages read the master table that the scan builds
res <- suppressMessages(pam_scan_audio(ex$cfg))
det <- suppressMessages(pam_assemble_detections(ex$cfg))
nrow(det)   # the batch file had one duplicate row, which is dropped
#> [1] 19
as.data.frame(det)[, c("filename", "species", "confidence", "start_time", "end_time")]
